channel.title: Governance Digest: lido
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Preventing Theft in Mainstream Wallets with Vaults (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to pledge $30,000 toward a $240,000 effort to get mainstream wallets to ship spending-limited savings vaults that limit losses from stolen seed phrases.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Production-Ready Local-First Safe UI (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to fund part of a $120,000 open RFP for a self-hosted, open-source Safe multisig interface, so teams are not tied to the hosted Safe{Wallet} frontend.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Decentralized, Privacy-Preserving EDR (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO for $30,000 toward a $300,000 open-source endpoint detection tool (EDR) for crypto teams, built by Auditware.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Assertions for Safes, Enforced on Every Transaction (lido)
item.description: Asks Lido's LEGO to put $10,000 toward a $75,000 Blossom Labs project that adds transaction-checking rules (assertions) directly to Safe multisigs.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: Fixing Shared Problems Before They Turn Into Lost Funds (lido)
item.description: TheDAO Security Fund asks Lido's LEGO grants program to back four Ethereum security projects with $95,000 total, either sent now or pledged until each project is fully funded.

item.title: Funding and Mandating an Independent Web3 Financial Audit & R&D Expenditures (lido)
item.description: A community proposal asks Lido DAO to fund an external financial audit of 2024-2026 R&D, payroll and product spending, with a target budget of $150,000 and a hard cap of $400,000.

item.title: Mitigating Correlated Risk: Framework for Hybrid CSM Deployments and Provider Diversity Scoring (lido)
item.description: A Lido research post proposes a blueprint for Community Staking Module operators to run hybrid home and cloud setups, plus a provider diversity score, to cut correlated outage and slashing risk.
